sourceNotes: 设置新增统一的全局快捷键页面，集中管理常用操作、截图与录屏快捷键，并检查重复绑定
启动台新增列表与分类浏览，支持大小图标及 7 × 5、8 × 5、8 × 6 网格布局
命令栏与启动台支持添加应用目录，完善网页应用名称与分类识别
优化启动台搜索、内容间距、文件夹展开与触控板翻页，网格优先填满前页，保留已有排序与文件夹
计时菜单默认打开时区页，便于直接查看所在时区、UTC 与美西时间
修复应用刷新后名称、图标及搜索状态未及时更新的问题，目录暂时不可用时保留已有布局
修复编辑或录制其他快捷键期间修改截图、录屏快捷键时，快捷键被提前重新启用的问题

en: Manage global shortcuts for common actions, screenshots, and screen recording on one settings page, with duplicate binding checks.
Add list and category browsing to Launchpad, with small or large icons and 7 × 5, 8 × 5, or 8 × 6 grids.
Add custom application directories for the command bar and Launchpad, and improve web app names and category recognition.
Refine Launchpad search, spacing, folder transitions, and trackpad paging; fill earlier grid pages while preserving existing ordering and folders.
Open the time zone tab by default from the timer menu for quick access to local, UTC, and US Pacific time.
Refresh application names, icons, and search state reliably, and preserve existing layouts when an application directory is temporarily unavailable.
Keep screenshot and screen recording shortcuts suspended when changing them while editing or recording other keyboard shortcuts.
